extracted.intended_audience: researchers/authors and readers of RUME (undergraduate mathematics education) conference proceedings
extracted.subtask_description: Publication and archival standards for the Research on Undergraduate Mathematics Education (RUME) conference proceedings, including peer-review/masking policy and notes about available proceedings and formats. Also a catalog of year-by-year proceedings PDFs and historical notes about content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer review and masking policy
rubrics_metrics.description: All reports published in the RUME conference proceedings are double-masked and peer-reviewed (generally by three or more reviewers).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statement indicates submissions are subject to double-masked review and typically evaluated by three or more reviewers; no further reviewer scoring rubric is provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: ISSN coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: All RUME proceedings are covered by the ISSN: 2474-9346.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the serial publication identifier used for bibliographic/archival purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proceedings content history / format expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: Conference proceedings began in 2002 with abstracts only. Proceedings volumes with abstracts and full papers began in 2007.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates that earlier (2002–2006) proceedings may include only abstracts, whereas later volumes may contain full papers; useful for expectations about available content in different years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of full proceedings (yearly PDFs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists Full Proceedings (PDF) files by year (e.g., 2025 Alexandria, VA — Full Proceedings (PDF, 86 MB); 2024 Omaha, NE — Full Proceedings (PDF, 120 MB); etc.) and notes special cases (e.g., 2021: No physical conference due to COVID-19; 2021 RUME Reports (PDF, 31.9 MB)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page functions as an index/catalog of downloadable proceedings by year with file-size metadata and occasional notes about format/meeting status.
